name: io.github.LifeAbundantly/akd-vaultpdf
title: AKD VaultPDF
description: Reads PDFs, resumes and CSVs on the user's own machine. Nothing is uploaded. Refuses rather than guesses: pointed at a date column it declines instead of returning a confident wrong total.

environmentVariables.name: VAULTPDF_SESSION
environmentVariables.description: Stripe Checkout Session id from a pass purchase (cs_...). Exchanged once for a day/week/month licence token, which is then cached. A pass is $2.22 for a day; there is no free tier for agents, because a client-side counter is not a gate in front of an AI.

environmentVariables.name: VAULTPDF_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A licence token already minted from a session. Use this instead of VAULTPDF_SESSION once you have one.
